audio.intro: Extract audio from videos and convert to MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, OGG and more formats, with customizable bitrate and segment extraction
audio.note: Note: For smooth processing, we recommend uploading video files under 200MB. Supports common formats such as MP4, WebM, AVI, MOV, MKV.

audio.formatChoice: Choose Format: For general sharing, we recommend MP3; for the highest fidelity, choose WAV; for Apple devices, choose M4A / AAC.
audio.bitrateChoice: Bitrate: Higher bitrate (kbps) means better quality but larger files. 128 kbps or 192 kbps is recommended for everyday listening.

audio.convertStep1: Click "Start Extraction" and wait for the progress bar to complete, then listen online and save to your device with one click.
audio.feature1: Pure Frontend Local Processing: Powered by WebAssembly (FFmpeg), files never leave your device, fully protecting your video privacy.
audio.feature2: Zero Dependencies, Ready to Use: No additional conversion software or browser plugins needed.
audio.feature3: Broad Format Compatibility: Extracts audio directly from mainstream video formats (MP4, WebM, AVI, MOV, MKV, etc.).
audio.faq1:
Why is there no sound in the extracted audio?
Make sure the original video actually contains an audio track (e.g., some surveillance or silent videos do not).
audio.faq2:
Will the extracted MP3 sound better than the original video?
No. The quality of the extracted audio is limited by the sample rate and bitrate of the source video's audio track. Increasing the bitrate (e.g., 320 kbps) only increases file size without improving damaged audio.
audio.faq3:
Why is large file extraction slow?
All audio/video decoding is done by your local device's CPU, so large files (or high-bitrate videos) require more decoding time — this is normal.
